Beat Luke Littler: Fallon Sherrock delighted to 'overcome the hate' and beat Littler in one-off leg to claim £501k prize
Fallon Sherrock defeated 'The Nuke' in the 'Beat Luke Littler' darts event on Netflix but her participation attracted criticism from some quarters; watch the Grand Slam of Darts in Wolverhampton live on Sky Sports from November 14-22
Saturday 31 October 2026 09:51, UK
Fallon Sherrock says she has "overcome the hate" after beating Luke Littler to win the second-biggest prize in darts history.
The 32-year-old was crowned champion of Netflix's 'Beat Luke Littler' on Friday night after she overcame the double world champion in a one-off leg of 501 to claim a mammoth £501,000 prize.
Only Littler himself has taken more from a single prize pot, the £1million he collected for his second World Championship in January.

This was not Sherrock's first foray into the limelight, as she created history by becoming the first woman to win at the World Championship when she made the third round seven years ago and she went on to break several other barriers in the game.
But her inclusion in the line-up for the TV show attracted criticism given her stature in the game, even if she met the criteria for applicants because she does not hold a PDC Tour Card.
"I mean it's been tough," she said. "Because obviously I do see the backlash and I do see all the negative comments.
"But at the end of the day, I fit the criteria for this. I've never had a tour card, and I wouldn't class myself as a pro really, because all I do is just play darts for the enjoyment of it.
"I think people forget where I started off as well. When I won at the Worlds, I was still just doing WDF (World Darts Federation).
"I'm just so happy to overcome all the hate and win."
Sherrock, who was the 15th competitor to take on Littler, was joined in the line-up by WDF number one Mitchell Lawrie, Mark Pooke, who played Phil Taylor in a professional event almost 20 years ago, and prodigious teenager Jayden Walker, who has taken a leg off Littler at an exhibition event.
There were also everyday players such as a bin man, an Australian jockey and a Nando's manager.
PDC chief Barry Hearn, who was involved in the audition process, defended the line-up.
Asked whether Sherrock's inclusion was unfair, he was unequivocal.
"No, not at all," said Hearn. "She's not a PDC Tour Card holder. She's entitled to enter. Why should she be denied?
"She's a well-known player and she's a very good player. But Mitchell Lawrie is a very well-known player and an excellent player.
"Do you want just a series of 20 matches where someone can't even throw a dart? No, of course we want excellence competing against excellence, and that's what it was all about."

digest_he: פאלון שרוק הצהירה כי הצליחה "להתגבר על השנאה" לעברה לאחר שניצחה את לוק ליטלר וזכתה בפרס השני בגודלו בתולדות משחק הדארטס. שרוק בת ה-32 הוכתרת כאלופת אירוע הדארטס המיוחד של נטפליקס לאחר שגברה על אלוף העולם הכפול בקרב חד-פעמי והבטיחה לעצמה פרס ענק בגובה 501,000 ליש"ט. שיתופה בתוכנית הטלוויזיה עורר ביקורת מצד גורמים שונים בענף בשל מעמדה, שכן היא אינה מחזיקה בכרטיס סיור מקצועי. שרוק הודתה כי התקופה האחרונה הייתה קשה וכי ראתה את כל התגובות השליליות והביקורת המכוונות כלפיה ברשתות. לדבריה, היא עמדה בכל הקריטריונים הנדרשים להשתתפות ואינה מגדירה את עצמה כשחקנית מקצוענית מלאה, אלא כמי שמשחקת דארטס להנאתה האישית. מנכ"ל ה-PDC, בארי הרן, הגן על הרכב המתמודדים ודחה את הטענות לפיהן הכללתה של שרוק הייתה לא הוגנת או לא ראויה.
